thread:
sara_support: Heads up: customer ACME reported mobile app sessions drop when switching from WiFi->cell. They see immediate 401 and reauth prompt. Happening intermittently for ~10% of sessions. Ticket #INC-4821.
ken_prodinfra: Do we have repro steps? device-binding enabled for their org?
sara_support: Repro steps from customer:
1) login on Android app (v3.2.1)
2) use app over WiFi for ~30s
3) toggle to cellular, app calls /v1/sessions/validate -> 401
They attached logs with cookies showing `device_assertion` present.
alex_sre: I can repro locally on emulator. When switching network, SYN/ACK resets cause socket reuse? But 401 suggests session cookie invalidated. Sharing curl of failing request:

```bash
curl -i -X GET "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sessions/validate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <session_token>" \
  -H "Cookie: session=abc123; device_assertion=da_789;"
```

Response snippet:

```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Set-Cookie: session=deleted; Max-Age=0; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=None
```

puneet_eng: Looking at logs: device_assertion TTL is 30s in prod for mobile device binding? That seems low. Also there's a cookie rotation job that runs every 60s - potential collision when switching networks triggers revalidate path and rotation simultaneously.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolled out cookie-rotation v2.3 at 2024-11-02T10:12Z to prod (canary).
ken_prodinfra: If rotation runs on validation path, race could delete session while assertion still valid. Can we get trace ids from customer logs?
sara_support: They provided trace id trace_abc123 (attached).
alex_sre: Checked trace: validator service returned 409 to rotation worker which then nuked session. Suggest throttle rotation to avoid running during auth flight. Assigning to @puneet_eng to propose fix.
puneet_eng: I'll change rotation job to use CAS and extend device_assertion TTL to 5m for mobile. Will open PR and request canary. ETA 4h.
sara_support: :thumbsup: I'll update customer and add to INC-4821. Also recommend customer upgrade to SDK v3.2.2 when released.
alex_sre: Leaving notes: add unit test for rotation vs validation; set alert for increased 401 spike on mobile-orgs.
ken_prodinfra: If urgent, temporary mitigation: set org config 'device_binding.strict' to false for ACME. Who can toggle?
puneet_eng: I can flip it for them, but will document rollback. Doing it now for org-789. Done.
alex_sre: Confirmed: 200 -> sessions/validate for trace_abc123 after toggle. Customer notified.
sara_support: Closing loop with customer, will follow up after deployment. Thanks team :sparkles:
